name: spendsmart
description: SpendSmart: AI budget tracker for college students (TCSS 460, Team 11)

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix gateway && npm install --prefix services/expense-service && npm install --prefix services/budget-service && npm install --prefix services/ai-service && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run start:api" "npm run start:web"
scripts.start:api: concurrently -k -n gateway,expenses,budgets,ai -c green,yellow,magenta,blue "npm start --prefix gateway" "npm start --prefix services/expense-service" "npm start --prefix services/budget-service" "npm start --prefix services/ai-service"
scripts.seed: npm run seed --prefix services/expense-service && npm run seed --prefix services/budget-service
